newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money market rates close high.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money market rates close high.

text.p: Pakistan's overnight money market rates soared to close at 20 percent from the opening 12 percent on Saturday owing to a State (central) Bank of Pakistan (SBP) special open market operation, dealers said.
Overnight deals started between 12 and 15 percent but and rose to 20 percent in the last hour of trade on the announcement of the operation results, one dealer said.

The SBP accepted some 4.95 billion rupees in the operation and borrowers had to avail the bank's discount window facility, he said. The rates were likely to remain high after Sunday's weekend holiday. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
